## About
Squire's Autowerke is an independent shop in Bellevue that specializes in air-cooled Porsches. We offer quality, personalized service, and that is all we focus on.
When Squire Tomasie retired, he sold the shop to Jason Williams, a Porsche mechanic who comes from a long line of mechanics. Jason worked as an FAA-licensed aircraft mechanic before moving to Seattle, then worked at a vintage VW and Porsche shop in Ballard and later with Chris Powell at Chris's German Auto Service in Bellevue.
Tony Turchin, a longtime veteran of Squire's Autowerke, still helps Jason out. We're committed to continuing the shop's legacy, and we're rated 5 on Google from 51 reviews.

## Services
- Independent Air-cooled Porsche Service and Repair: Quality, personalized service and repairs for your air-cooled Porsche.
- Shop labor rate: Our standard labor rate for service and repairs. ($250/hour)
- Service/repairs with customer supplied parts: We can work with parts you bring in, at a separate labor rate. ($300/hour)
- Valve adjust: One reviewer came back to have a valve adjust done and an oil leak fixed.
- Brake work: One reviewer said Jason and the team worked through a brake issue on his car.

## FAQ
Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: Email us at service@squiresautowerke.com and we'll get you on the schedule.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Thursday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. We're closed Friday through Sunday.

Q: Do you close for lunch?
A: Yes, from noon to 1:00 p.m. Please respect our lunch break. Forks and spoons are the only tools we use at lunch.

Q: Can I bring my own parts?
A: Yes. The labor rate for service and repairs with customer supplied parts is $300/hour.
